about: Gran Turismo 7 01.710.000 World Circuits single races. Ids, course labels and 1st prizes were recorded from the game's event loader while opening every World Circuits location; names, tracks, race minutes (gtplus.app estimates for a winning race) and difficulty (community reports, else the chili rating) come from the community event lists at gtplus.app and the Gran Turismo fandom wiki. same_track_and_prize: another race shares track and prize, so its name may be swapped with that race's.
